beats.care: Travelling home this weekend? Leave early or very late, and check live traffic before you start.
beats.what: Massive jams hit Mysuru Road, Tumakuru Road, airport road and Hosur Road. Goraguntepalya and Yeshwanthpur flyover were among the worst spots.
beats.why: Dasara, Ayudha Puja and the weekend fell together, so thousands left the city at once. Light rain made it worse.

cards.body: Deccan Herald and Public TV both reported commuters stuck for about six hours.
cards.caption: longest reported wait in traffic

cards.body: Stuck travellers called local traffic police stations for help. Some said traffic management fell short despite a rush everyone saw coming.
cards.title: Commuters vent

opts: Many holidays falling together, so everyone left at once
cards.why: Dasara, Ayudha Puja and the weekend lined up, so huge numbers left Bengaluru on the same night.

cards.q: How are you getting home for Dasara?

hook: Why did getting *out of Bengaluru* take six hours on Friday?

learn.t: Some private buses heading out of Bengaluru that night only left the city around 3 to 4 am on Saturday.

sources.name: Deccan Herald
sources.title: Dasara rush leaves Bengaluru motorists stranded in traffic for six hours

sources.name: Public TV
sources.title: Record traffic jam in Bengaluru: passengers stuck on the road for 6 hours

tldr: People leaving Bengaluru for the Dasara holidays were stuck in traffic for up to six hours on Friday night.
